errors.problem: $\mathbf 1$ denotes both the identity matrix and the all-ones vector; read as the identity (as in $\mathbf 1-J/9$ and later $P_{U_a^\perp}+P_{U_a}=\mathbf 1$), $J=\mathbf 1\mathbf 1^{\mathsf T}$ would be the identity. The paper writes $I-J/9$ with $J$ the all-one matrix.

errors.quote: $P_V-P_U$ is the identity on $V\cap U^\perp$ and zero elsewhere
errors.problem: \"Elsewhere\" should be the orthogonal complement of $V\cap U^\perp$ with respect to the form $I-J/9$, not the standard one. The paper says \"zero on its orthogonal complement\", with $P_U$ the projection along $U^\perp$.

errors.quote: Gate labels at times $0,\dots,7$ (tensored with $R$) for neighbors $S,T$ at $X,Y$: $B\otimes\langle t\rangle,\ B\otimes F,\dots$
errors.problem: The time-0 label uses an undefined $t$ (it should be the $Y$ triple's indicator, $t_T$ in the page's naming). Putting $S$ at $X$ and $T$ at $Y$ also reverses the paper's convention ($x_T$ controls, $y_S$ targets), so a reader using the paper's names would swap the indicators at times 2 and 5.

errors.quote: Undoing the bank exchange gives all roles $C^{\otimes m}$.
errors.problem: The scalar exchange is signed, $(X_a,Y_a)\mapsto(-Y_a,X_a)$. The paper also negates the physical $X$ outputs before sending $\rho(w)$ back to $w$. An unsigned undoing leaves $-C^{\otimes m}$ on the $Y_a\to X_a$ route.
